description: Figshare publishes a structured workbook of public agrometeorological warning messages for the black-soil region of Northeast China during 2021–2023. The XLSX file records announcement time, affected county, hazard type, warning level and descriptive details extracted from warning text. The repository states CC BY 4.0 with public access and no fee. These event records can test warning thresholds or compare agriculture and irrigation service-response scenarios with the timing of issued alerts. They are warnings made by public agencies, not direct measurements of crop loss, flood depth or actual warning reach. Administrative coverage and reporting practice may change; one alert can span several counties or hazards. The published workbook is distinct from a weather station or gridded climate product. It complements data-era5-reanalysis, which supplies physical weather fields, not alert decisions. No workbook was downloaded. A limitation is that an issued warning does not prove that every farmer received or acted on it.
